question: By how many kJ/kg does the optimization of the hydroquinone-catechol vacuum distillation reduce the total specific energy consumption, including the vacuum pumps?
rendered:
Rigorous Modeling and Industrial-Scalable Optimization of Hydroquinone-Catechol Vacuum Distillation: Aspen Plus-RSM Integration for Thermally Labile Systems

The optimization of the hydroquinone-catechol vacuum distillation process reduces the total specific energy consumption, including the vacuum pumps, by 23.2% compared to the industrial baseline operating condition.
